description: This file defines extension methods for configuring different types of queue balancers in Orleans streaming within the silo persistent stream configurator. It provides methods to set up consistent ring, static cluster, dynamic cluster, and lease-based queue balancers.

classes.name: SiloPersistentStreamConfiguratorExtension
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for ISiloPersistentStreamConfigurator to configure various queue balancers.

methods.name: UseConsistentRingQueueBalancer
methods.description: Configures the stream provider to use the consistent ring queue balancer.

methods.name: UseStaticClusterConfigDeploymentBalancer
methods.description: Configures the stream provider to use the static cluster configuration deployment balancer, with optional silo maturity period.

methods.name: UseDynamicClusterConfigDeploymentBalancer
methods.description: Configures the stream provider to use the dynamic cluster configuration deployment balancer, with optional silo maturity period.

methods.name: UseLeaseBasedQueueBalancer
methods.description: Configures the stream provider to use the lease-based queue balancer, with optional configuration options.
